produtos.title: S.O.S 3-Step Set
produtos.body_html:
Your Emergency Skincare Rescue, Before or During a Breakout.

Breakouts don't always come with a warning. Meet your new skincare S.O.S kit, a targeted 3-step routine designed to help comfort stressed skin, manage excess oil, and care for visible blemishes before or during a breakout.

Featuring our award-winning 345 Relief Cream, this trio combines refreshing daytime care, lightweight hydration, and targeted overnight spot care to help your skin feel calm and balanced when it needs extra attention.

produtos.title: Tiktok Trending Set
produtos.body_html:
Your TikTok Favorites, All in One Set!

Specially curated collection featuring six of the products our TikTok community has been most curious about.

From our award-winning 345 Relief Cream to our brightening essentials, refreshing facial mists, and nourishing Lash Boost Serum, this collection brings together a variety of skincare favorites in one exclusive bundle.

Discover lightweight hydration, brighter-looking skin, targeted dark spot care, refreshing on-the-go comfort, and healthier-looking lashes, all while exploring the products that caught your attention on TikTok.

produtos.body_html:

Featuring four complementary formulas, this set helps remove daily buildup, refine rough-looking skin, soften stubborn sebum, and replenish essential moisture without leaving your skin feeling weighed down.

produtos.title: Premium Quick Step Sebum Cleanser
produtos.body_html:
What It Is:
Premium Quick Step Sebum Cleanser is a mild cleanser that removes excess sebum and deep cleans pores. 

It is a moisturizing liquid type that can be absorbed well into the skin and effectively loosens the sebum of pores out of the skin, leaving your skin clean and refreshed.

Benefits:
- Mild Deep Cleanser
- Sebum & Pore Care
- Plant-Derived Complex Extract

Effects:
It  is a mild liquid-type cleanser that extracts deeply embedded sebum.

Instead of physically irritating the area, its water formulation saturates the sebum area, which cleans the skin without irritation.

produtos.title: Eye Essential Trio
produtos.body_html:
Refresh tired-looking eyes. Smooth fine lines. Nourish your lashes.

The Eye Essential Trio brings together targeted under-eye care, firming hydration, and daily lash conditioning in one complete routine. Designed to address puffiness, fine lines, loss of elasticity, and fragile-looking lashes, this trio helps restore a refreshed, smoother, and more youthful-looking eye area while keeping lashes soft and nourished. Your everyday essential for brighter-looking eyes and healthier-looking lashes.

produtos.title: Aqua Pore Duo
produtos.body_html: The Aqua Pore Duo combines the Pore Refresh Grinding Cleansing Balm to gently remove excess oil and impurities without stripping moisture, and the Aqua Marine Watery Cream to replenish deep hydration and help balance dehydrated skin, leaving it feeling clean, soft, and refreshed while keeping pores looking clear and refined.

produtos.title: Eye Essential Duo
produtos.body_html:
Refreshed-looking under-eyes and softer lashes in two lightweight steps.
The Hydra Caffeine Eye Patch helps refresh puffy-looking, tired under-eyes and smooth the look of fine lines made more noticeable by dryness. Follow with Lash Boost Serum for lightweight water-gel conditioning that moisturizes and nourishes lashes without a heavy feel.
An easy daily duo for keeping tired-looking eyes and dry, fragile-looking lashes refreshed, soft, and cared for.

produtos.title: Rapid Mild Acid Rescue Pore Pad
produtos.body_html:
What It Is:  
A daily pore-care pad made with 100% pure rayon, soaked in a triple-acid (AHA·BHA·PHA) essence that gently clears away dead skin cells and excess sebum from the very first step of your routine. Its EF-shaped structure locks in a generous amount of essence, while a menthol-derived cooling ingredient delivers an instant refresh with every swipe — leaving skin smooth, clear, and makeup-ready.

Benefits:
- 4-in-1 pore care for smoother, more refined-looking skin
- Instant cooling, soothing feel from menthol and cornmint oil
- Gentle, low-irritation rayon pad for daily use, all skin types

Effects:
With continued use, skin texture looks smoother and more even, pores appear visibly refined, and skin feels calm, cool, and comfortable rather than stripped or tight. The result is a clear, hydrated base that helps makeup glide on smoothly.

produtos.title: Hydra Caffeine Eye Patch
produtos.body_html:
What It Is: 
An all-in-one slow-aging eye patch engineered with advanced dual-layer insoluble hydrogel technology. Infused with caffeine, pure retinol, and bakuchiol, it hugs the skin tightly without slipping to instantly refresh, lift, and brighten tired under-eyes while delivering deep, long-lasting moisture.

Benefits:
- Targeted Dark Circle & Puffiness Care
- Resilient Firming & Anti-Aging
- No-Slip Insoluble Hydrogel Fit

Effects:
Creates a protective "Moisture Microenvironment" that minimizes moisture loss while delivering powerful active ingredients directly into the skin. Clinically tested for dark circle, skin firmness, and sensitive skin irritation, this vegan patch visibly lifts, hydrates, and smooths delicate under-eyes without slipping or causing irritation.

produtos.title: Calming Essential Duo
produtos.body_html:
Strong UV exposure, heat, sweat, excess oil, and constant air conditioning can leave skin feeling hot, dehydrated, irritated, and more prone to breakouts.

The Green Tea Fresh Sunscreen provides lightweight daily UV protection with a watery, fast-absorbing texture that feels comfortable even on hot, humid days. Formulated with Green Tea and soothing ingredients, it is especially suited for sensitive, redness-prone, and acne-prone skin.

Pair it with the 345 Relief Cream, a lightweight, non-comedogenic moisturizer designed to calm stressed and post-breakout skin while replenishing hydration and supporting the skin barrier.

Together, they create an essential summer routine: protect your skin from daily UV exposure, then soothe and replenish the moisture summer stress can take away.

Everything your skin needs to stay comfortable through summer.

produtos.body_html:
What It Is: 
Infused with natural ingredients such as Green Tea Extract and Guaiazulene to effectively clean deep within pores and control excess sebum to keep your skin clear without irritation or discomfort.

This cleansing balm has an innovative grinding mechanism built into the packaging and a sorbet-like texture to ensure hygienic and convenient use without direct hand contact with the product.

Benefits:
- Deep Pore Cleansing
- Gentle yet Effective Makeup Remover
- Hydrating Finish

Effects:
Effortlessly remove sunscreen, makeup, and even waterproof products while controlling pore cleanliness with just a small amount.

produtos.title: PDRN Reju 10000 Cream
produtos.body_html:
What It Is:  
An intensive, high-performance firming cream powered by 10,000 ppm of 95% high-purity Salmon PDRN. Formulated with advanced Boostersome technology and Deep Derma Jet delivery , this ointment-style gel cream penetrates deeply to soothe stressed skin, restore elasticity, and visibly improve skin density without heavy or sticky residue.

Benefits:
- 10,000 ppm High-Purity Salmon PDRN Care
- Advanced Dual Boosterosome Delivery
- Barrier Recovery & Deep Soothing

Effects:
By delivering a concentrated blend of Salmon PDRN, EGF, Bio-NAD, Quercetin, and Glycyrrhetinic Acid via micro-targeted technology, this cream activates cellular vitality and defends against daily oxidative stress. It visibly restores skin firmness, deeply hydrates across multi-layer skin depths, and leaves a smooth, healthy glow without clogging pores.

produtos.title: Green Tea Calming Sunscreen
produtos.body_html:
A lightweight daily facial sunscreen that protects sensitive, redness-prone, and acne-prone skin from UV exposure without feeling heavy or greasy. It helps prevent sunlight from worsening redness, dullness, and post-acne marks while leaving the skin comfortable and naturally fresh. Its fast-absorbing texture sits smoothly under makeup and is especially well suited to oily and combination skin.

Effects:
It combines the benefits of Green Tea Extract and Camellia Sinensis Leaf Water to protect and soothe the skin, making it an excellent choice for those with acne-prone or sensitive skin.

produtos.title: Rapid Hypochlorous Acid Rescue Mist
produtos.body_html:
What It Is:
A rapid skin-rescuing daily mist formulated with Hypochlorous Acid (HOCl) and 20% Tea Tree Leaf Water to instantly soothe irritated skin and restore a clean, healthy balance. Engineered with a ultra-fine mist spray, this clear water-type formula purifies the skin surface, regulates excess oil, and calms sudden breakouts without leaving any sticky residue.

Benefits:
- Instant Soothing & Purification
- Synergistic Anti-Blemish & Oil Control
- Ultra-Fine & Weightless Refreshment

Effects:
By creating a clean and balanced skin environment, this daily rescue mist effectively alleviates skin distress caused by environmental stressors. Certified non-comedogenic and dermatologically tested for sensitive skin, it leaves your complexion calm, clarified, and comfortably hydrated.

produtos.title: PDRN Reju 2000 Cream
produtos.body_html:
What It Is: 
PDRN Reju 2000 Cream is a high-performance recovery treatment designed to recharge tired skin and restore foundational vitality. This lightweight, ointment-to-gel formula features 0.2% ultra-pure Alaska Salmon DNA (PDRN) to deeply soothe irritation while boosting the skin’s natural resilience. Engineered with advanced Ampule Release Technology, it delivers the intensive nourishment of a clinical treatment with a breathable, non-sticky finish—making it the perfect daily "calm and boost" solution for modern, stressed skin.

Benefits:
- Revives tired skin with Salmon PDRN
- Soothes irritation with Panthenol & Ectoin
- Lightweight moisture barrier support

Effects:
By infusing Nano-Hyaluronic Acid with high-purity PDRN and 4 types of EGF, this formula targets the look of skin texture and elasticity at a foundational level. Biome PDRN Liposomes ensure optimal delivery of Ceramides and Madecassoside, helping to maintain a balanced oil-moisture environment even for sensitive skin. The result is a resilient, "glass-skin" complexion that feels supple, hydrated, and protected against daily environmental stressors.

produtos.body_html:

This lightweight hydrating retinol moisturizer helps improve the appearance of fine lines, uneven skin tone, and loss of firmness while supporting skin barrier comfort. Suitable as a daily retinol night cream, it can be used across the entire face for balanced firming care.

Benefits:
- Gentle Retinol Care for Beginners
- Firming & Barrier Support
- Lightweight Hydrating Texture

Effects:
Formulated with Retinol and Bakuchiol, this firming retinol cream helps smooth the appearance of wrinkles and support a clearer, more refined complexion.
The soothing complex and hydrating ingredients help maintain skin comfort and strengthen the moisture barrier with continued use.

Hyaloveil™ provides deep hydration, while the Moist Retention System forms a breathable moisture barrier to lock in active ingredients and maintain lasting softness and shine.
